issue.title: [bst-1] Upgrade pylint when it gets fixed
issue.body:
In `bst-1` branch we're holding back `pylint` at version 2.8.3, due to a [crash introduced in pylint >= 2.9.0](https://github.com/PyCQA/pylint/issues/4837)

After the upstream issue is fixed we can update pylint again and address warnings the new linter might introduce.

body: Thank you for taking the time to report this. Love the example with default pink ponyz.
